items.reason: Gap 0 describes a retry running concurrently with the first delivery so both workers pass the Set check and run the handler twice.
Gap 2 says the key comes from the unsigned X-Event-Id header and a signed body replayed with a modified header runs again.
Gap 3 says the provider sends charge.refunded while HANDLERS registers refund.created, so refunds are dropped.
No gap depends on multiple processes or replicas; the concurrency described is within the one queue.
